findings.description: Remove pending and append same point to committed and aggregate arrays before optional run-step recording. PH callback must return before pending clear; absent callback means no invalidation, but reversal is still recomputed. Final pending prospective cycle results including null-point states can contribute status and post-PL3 Orders. First and last cycle are indexed directly without empty-cycle fallback; first physical duplicate wins before stable sort.
